question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation.**

Although she didn't reveal her plans clearly, I had a ________ idea.
solution:
The correct answer is: **rough**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Rough idea' **is a basic **collocation **meaning **a vague or approximate idea, concept, memory, etc.**

 
 
• Example: I can't remember exactly when we left, but I've got a** rough idea.**
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Despite the fact that she did not share her ideas in detail, I had a basic notion.
 
• So, as per the context of the sentence "**rough**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 

**Complete sentence:** *Although she didn't reveal her plans clearly, I had a **rough idea__**.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• Clear: Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. (देखने, समझने या व्याख्या करने में आसान)
 
• Concise: Giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive. (बहुत सारी जानकारी स्पष्ट रूप से और कुछ शब्दों में देना; संक्षिप्त लेकिन व्यापक)
 
• Complete: Having all the necessary or appropriate parts. (सभी आवश्यक या उपयुक्त भाग होना)
